component.name: RigMatch
component.summary: Find the best local AI model your computer can run

description.p: RigMatch finds the AI models that run well on your own computer, then has them compete so you can pick a winner. It reads your graphics card and memory, suggests models that fit, and asks every contestant the same questions on your hardware: answer quality, speed and fit are measured here, not quoted from somewhere else.
Everything stays on your computer. Models run through Ollama; RigMatch needs no account and sends none of your prompts anywhere.

ul.li: Simple Mode walks you through checking your PC, picking models, and a head-to-head show that crowns your Top Match
Advanced Mode shows every model that fits your graphics card, with custom tests, scorecards and diagnostics
Image, video and audio models can be tested too, on your own ComfyUI
